name: Sacred Fire
summary: Hunters seek Incendia Agave at the Boiling Pool to prepare a sacred fire that can call Arikara from the canyons of Thousand Needles.

sections.title: Kindling the Spirit
sections.body: Motega Firemane instructs hunters to prepare the sacred fire of life, an ancient flame that calls the spirit beast Arikara. The monstrous wind serpent cannot simply be tracked across the canyon floor; she must be drawn to the fire. The flame needs more than ordinary kindling. Rare Incendia Agave, which grows around the scalding waters of Thousand Needles, feeds it.

sections.title: The Boiling Pool
sections.body: Incendia Agave grows near the Boiling Pool, below Darkcloud Pinnacle. To gather the spiky plants, you brave blistering waters and steam elementals drifting through the mists. Many bushels grow beneath the surface, where the hot lake water tests every hunter sent to collect them.

sections.title: The Elder's Blessing
sections.body: Raw agave cannot ignite the ritual brazier. You carry the harvested plants from the plains to Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. There, Magatha Grimtotem grinds and enchants the leaves into potent ritual powder, eager to see the vengeful beast challenged.

faq.q: What is the sacred fire of life?
faq.answer: The sacred fire of life is a ritual flame used to summon the vengeful spirit serpent Arikara. Without it, the beast remains hidden and beyond reach.
Incendia Agave grows in and around the Boiling Pool in Thousand Needles, near Darkcloud Pinnacle. Many of the spiky plants lie beneath the hot lake water.

faq.q: Why must Magatha Grimtotem enchant the agave?
faq.answer: Raw Incendia Agave lacks the power to ignite the sacred fire. Magatha Grimtotem uses her shamanic craft to enchant the leaves into powder that can awaken the dormant flame.
Arikara is a wind serpent born to deliver vengeance against those who commit terrible crimes. Motega Firemane sees her presence as an imminent peril that hunters must confront swiftly.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Sacred Fire?
faq.answer: Motega Firemane gives it in Thousand Needles after you help him with his initial tasks concerning the local serpent threat.

faq.q: Why does Magatha smile when she hears of Arikara?
faq.answer: No explanation is given for Magatha Grimtotem's smile. She smiles after describing Arikara as a creature born to punish heinous acts, leaving you to wonder what she thinks.

angles.text: As a tauren hunter, you honor the spirits through ritual hunting and face the elders' politics on Elder Rise as part of a rite of adulthood.
As a shaman, you see elemental power infused into natural plants like Incendia Agave.
As an herbalist, you can track the submerged spiky bushels of Incendia Agave across the Boiling Pool.
As a member of the Horde, you carry out trials for the elders and strengthen ties across Kalimdor's arid flatlands.
